segmentation.text: outside of a business or residence district
no person shall stop, park or leave standing
upon the paved or main-traveled part of the highway
when it is practicable to stop, park or so leave such vehicle off such part of the highway,
but in every event an unobstructed width of the highway opposite a standing vehicle shall be left
for the free passage of other vehicles
and a clear view of such stopped vehicles shall be available from a distance of 200 feet in each direction upon such highway.
This section shall not apply to the driver of any vehicle which is disabled
while on the paved or main-traveled portion of a highway
in such manner and to such extent that it is impossible to avoid stopping and temporarily leaving such disabled vehicle in such position.

elements.justification: Upon any highway: x's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) a st.highway, 'the entire public way between its boundary lines', as the mapping index maps 'upon any highway'.
'any vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, the subject's class.

The paved or main-traveled part of the highway is the st.roadway, 'the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic, excluding shoulder', lying on the highway (st.on_way), which x's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies): the standing vehicle the width is left opposite is one upon that part.

A standing vehicle (DEF-NRS-484A-250, 'the halting of a vehicle, whether occupied or not') is x halted, drv.motion.stopped. An unobstructed width of the highway opposite it is a st.lane ('a longitudinal strip of roadway for one line of vehicles') of the same highway (st.on_way) that x's footprint does not overlap (rel.occupies) and that no other halted road user occupies alongside x (rel.longitudinal_overlap, 'the length the two footprints' projections on that axis share', not negative).
While on the paved or main-traveled portion: x's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) the st.roadway at the observation.

operationalizations.convention: Free passage of other vehicles is read through the width of the lane left opposite the standing vehicle: st.lane_width ('width of a lane at a point') at least the width a design vehicle needs to pass, so the measured width enters the bound.

assumptions.meaning: The stretch of highway at the observation lies within territory classed as a business district or as a residence district.
The road user's vehicle is disabled: it cannot proceed under its own power at the observation.
The road user's vehicle cannot be moved from the place where it stands at the observation, by its own power or otherwise.

residues.why: Attended or unattended, the duty is the same: the words name both cases and exclude neither.

applicability: x is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle occupying a highway h and the roadway rw lying on it (st.roadway, st.on_way(rw, h)); asm.business_or_residence_district is false; x is halted (drv.motion.stopped with p.motion_speed_tolerance); and not the exception: not (asm.vehicle_disabled and x occupies a roadway and asm.disabled_vehicle_immovable).
obligation: Some st.lane l with st.on_way(l, h) is not occupied by x, has st.lane_width at least p.free_passage_width, and is occupied alongside x (rel.longitudinal_overlap with x not negative) by no other road user that is halted (drv.motion.stopped). Violated where no such lane is left opposite the standing vehicle.

narrowings.why: The unobstructed width is read as a whole lane of the same highway left beside the standing vehicle, free of other halted road users alongside it; width left in part of a lane, and obstruction by objects other than road users, are not read.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: On a rural highway with two lanes, district assumption false and disabled assumptions false, a car halts in one lane while a truck halts alongside it in the other lane.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The car halts in one lane; the other lane, wider than the free passage width, is free alongside it.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The car drives along the highway without halting.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The car halts in one lane of a two-lane highway; the source supplies no lane widths.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The car halts in one lane of a two-lane highway and no other road user is in the scene.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: The car halts on a highway whose roadway has a single lane, so no lane is left opposite it.

param_proposals.name: p.motion_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: Speed resolution: the noise floor of a source's speed estimate, below which a road user is read as standing still.
param_proposals.source: Speed-estimate noise of tracked road users.

param_proposals.name: p.free_passage_width
param_proposals.convention: Width a passing design vehicle needs: the 8.5 ft (2.6 m) design vehicle width plus a shy margin of about 0.4 m.
param_proposals.source: AASHTO A Policy on Geometric Design of Highways and Streets (design vehicle dimensions).
